title: GENERATIVE VALUE CONFLICTS REVEAL LLM PRIORITIES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model preferences in automatically generated scenarios where two moral or ethical values conflict (e.g., helpfulness vs. harmlessness, personal vs. protective values) using both multiple-choice questions and open-ended simulated user interactions to derive a Bradley-Terry ranking of the models' preferred values.
Computing the change in a model's value preference rate when a value is associated with taking no action in a scenario compared to when it is associated with taking an action.
